attributes.action: Dont end disable tax class excempt ulez charges in October 2027
attributes.additional_details:
Disabled tax diesel cars are excempt from ULEZ charges, But they wanna end the disabled tax class from excempt charges in October 2027. and beleive this is unfair and if you get rewarded disabled tax for life time your car should be excempt from charges for that life time and they shouldnt end the exemption in October 2027 as they plan
We want it remaining and not end the exemption in October 2027 for disabled tax and should continue excempt from charges as long as you receive disabled tax class
attributes.background:
Disabled people whose vehicles are registered with the DVLA as having disabled vehicle tax class benefit from a grace period which exempts them from paying the ULEZ charge until 24 October 2027 and after this date they want to end that 

We wanna scrap this date and remain  excempt from charges

rejection.details:
this is a matter for TfL/London Mayor/London Assembly - you can start a petition with the London Assembly here:
